consent.text: I agree that these recordings are used by Abdullah Haroon to test Nabz Scribe, a research project at FAST-NUCES Lahore. They will not be published or shared outside the project, and I can ask for them to be deleted at any time. The visits are role-play: I will not use my own real health details or any real patient's name.

recordings.title: Typhoid
recordings.script: Mareez mard, 28 saal. Paanch din se tez bukhar hai, sar dard aur kamzori bhi hai. Kehnda ae raat nu bohat thand lagdi ae. Ulti nahi hai, dast bhi nahi. Typhoid ka test positive aaya hai. Azomax 500 rozana ek goli, saat din. Panadol do goli din mein teen baar, jab bukhar ho. Teen din baad dobara aayein.

recordings.title: Dengue
recordings.script: Khatoon, 34 saal. Teen din se bukhar, jism mein dard, aur aankhon ke peeche dard. Platelets 95 hazaar hain. Kahin se khoon nahi aa raha. Sirf Panadol do goli din mein teen baar. Brufen bilkul nahi leni, Disprin bhi nahi. Paani zyada piyein. Kal khoon ka test dobara karwana hai.

recordings.title: Loose motions
recordings.script: Mard, 40 saal. Kal raat se dast lage hain, aath nau dafa ho chuke hain. Dast mein khoon nahi hai. Jism mein thori paani ki kami hai. Har dast ke baad ORS ka ek glass. Flagyl 400 din mein teen baar, paanch din. Doodh aur tali hui cheezein band. Agar peshab kam ho jaye to foran wapas aayein.

recordings.title: High BP
recordings.script: Khatoon, 55 saal. Aaj BP 160 aur 100 aaya hai. Sar bhaari rehta hai, chakkar nahi aate. Seene mein dard nahi hai. Norvasc 5 raat ko ek goli shuru kar di hai. Namak kam karna hai. Do hafte baad BP dobara check karwayein.

recordings.title: Sugar follow up
recordings.script: Mard, 50 saal, sugar ka purana mareez. Nihar mun sugar 180 aur khane ke baad 260. Pehle Glucophage 500 din mein do baar le raha tha. Ab Glucophage 1000 din mein do baar, khane ke saath. Teen mahine wala sugar test karwana hai. Pairon mein sun hona nahi hai.

recordings.title: Stomach burning
recordings.script: Khatoon, 30 saal. Pait ke upar jalan hoti hai, khane ke baad zyada. Kehndi ae khatte dakaar aunde ne. Ulti nahi, wazan kam nahi hua. Risek 20 subah khali pait, do hafte. Raat ko Gaviscon ke do chamach. Chai aur mirch kam karein.

recordings.title: Chest infection
recordings.script: Mard, 45 saal. Ek hafte se khansi, peela balgham, aur halka bukhar. Saans nahi phoolta. Seene ki daayin taraf awaaz aa rahi hai. Augmentin 625 din mein do baar, paanch din. Khansi ka syrup do chamach din mein teen baar. Cigarette band karni hai. Chest X-ray karwa lein.

recordings.title: Urine infection
recordings.script: Khatoon, 26 saal. Do din se peshab mein jalan hai aur baar baar aata hai. Bukhar nahi, kamar mein dard nahi. Pregnant nahi hain. Cipro 500 din mein do baar, teen din. Paani zyada piyein. Peshab ka test karwa lein. Teen din mein farq na pare to dobara aayein.

recordings.title: Asthma
recordings.script: Mard, 22 saal. Raat ko saans ki takleef aur seene se seeti ki awaaz aati hai, ghabrahat hundi ae. Bukhar nahi. Ventolin inhaler, zaroorat par do puff, din mein chaar dafa se zyada nahi. Raat ko Zyrtec ek goli. Dhool aur dhuen se bachein.

recordings.title: Allergy follow up
recordings.script: Khatoon, 38 saal, sirf follow up ke liye aayi hain. Pichhli dawai se koi rash nahi hua, koi side effect nahi. Bukhar nahi, khansi nahi. Penicillin se allergy hai, is liye Augmentin nahi deni. Zyrtec aadhi goli raat ko, das din. Ek mahine baad dikhayein.

recordings.title: Knee pain
facts: Knee pain for 2 months, worse on stairs

recordings.title: Sore throat
facts: Sore throat and fever for 2 days
Warm salt-water gargles 3 times a day
Come back if not better in 3 days

recordings.title: Evening headache
facts: Headache in the evenings for 1 week
No problem with eyesight, no vomiting
Panadol when needed, eat less salt
